text.lead:
Watch on the Rhine (German: Die Wacht am Rhein or Aus des Rheinlands Schicksalstagen) is a 1926 German silent historical film directed by Helene Lackner and starring Hans Mierendorff, Ernst Winar and Gustav Adolf Semler.
The film's art direction was by Karl Machus.
text.cast:
- Hans Mierendorff as Franz Großmann - Großindustrieller
- Ernst Winar as René Clavignac - franz. Kapitän
- Gustav Adolf Semler as Charles Daumont - Franz. Ingenieur
- Walter Slezak as Walter Thiermann - Ing. bei Großmann
- Frida Richard as Frau Thiermann - dessen alte Mutter
- Maria Zelenka as Maria Kreuz
- Ernst Behmer
- Colette Brettel
- Maria Forescu
- Stani Frenzel
- Robert Garrison
- Mira Hart
- Margarete Kupfer
- Robert Leffler
- Hertha Müller
- Lotte Müller
- Ernst Pittschau
- Elza Temary
